data.name: Bhudeva
data.gender_notes: Bhudeva is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhudeva is a Sanskrit name derived from the two words 'Bhu' meaning 'Earth' and 'Deva' meaning 'God'. The name signifies the deity who is the ruler of the earth. The name Bhudeva carries the meaning “God of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhudeva usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Honoring the divine presence in all things earthly.
data.etymology: Bhudeva belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhudeva total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bhudeva holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as it refers to a deity who is not just a ruler but also the protector of the earth and its inhabitants. The name is often used to invoke blessings for the well-being of the earth and its people. In various Hindu rituals and traditions, offerings are made to Bhudeva for his blessings of prosperity and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: Bhudeva is also a spiritual symbol representing the concept of God being present in every aspect of creation, including the earth and its inhabitants. The name carries an innate sense of reverence and awe for the divine presence that sustains the earth and all living beings. Bhudeva is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and our responsibility to care for the earth and its inhabitants as an expression of reverence for the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhudeva: Servant of Mother Earth; embodiment of love and respect for the natural world. In Hinduism, the name Bhudeva carries a deep symbolic meaning, reflecting one's connection to the Earth and the natural world. Bhudeva signifies a deep reverence and love for Mother Earth, making the individual a devoted servant to the land that sustains us all. This name embodies the spiritual belief in the interconnectedness of all living beings and our responsibility to protect and preserve the Earth for future generations.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bhudeva was a king of the Vakataka dynasty in the 5th century AD. The name Bhudeva carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
